description: Distinct integers past 2^53 are distinct enum members.
descriptor: { descriptor_version: "1.0", root: { type: "object", children: { a: { type: "number", enum: [9007199254740993] } } } }

divergence.note: The baseline compares every numeric const/enum member through float(), so two distinct integers above the exactly representable range collapse to the same double: an enum of [9007199254740993] accepts the value 9007199254740992. docs/grammars.md §2 forbids silent rounding; the Dart implementation compares exactly and rejects the different integer.
